stories.h: SR 167 Expressway tolls start Dec. 14 in Fife
stories.s: Drivers between I-5 and SR 509 near the Port of Tacoma will pay $1 with a Good To Go pass, and at least $2 more without one. Trucks pay extra per axle.

stories.h: Pierce Transit moves to buy up to 60 buses
stories.s: With Proposition 1 appearing to pass, the board unanimously authorized the CEO to buy or refurbish up to 60 buses. He said manufacturing slots need to be secured early because of supply backlogs.

stories.h: JBLM soldier gets 70 years for Gorge festival killings
stories.s: Spc. James Kelly pleaded guilty at a court-martial to killing two Seattle nurses at a 2023 Gorge Amphitheatre festival campground. He will serve his sentence at Fort Leavenworth.

stories.h: Parkland resident holds intruder at gunpoint until deputies arrive
stories.s: A 40-year-old man pleaded not guilty after allegedly entering a Parkland home Sunday night. A judge set bail at $3,000 and ordered him to stay out of the neighborhood.

stories.h: New SR 507 roundabout opens near Spanaway
stories.s: A single-lane roundabout at SR 507 and 208th Street South is complete. Crews are finishing a second one at SR 702 and Harts Lake Road and expect to wrap up in November, weather permitting.

coming.h: Live at the Eleanor: Trío Guadalevín in Tacoma
coming.s: Tacoma Arts Live presents the concert in the Tacoma Armory's Roosevelt Room.

coming.h: Arts at the Armory weekend in Tacoma
coming.s: Tacoma Arts Live's Arts at the Armory event runs Saturday and Sunday at the Tacoma Armory on Yakima Avenue.
